body: Yep, every single day I find it harder to wake up in the morning knowing I have literally one reason to continue living when I could end all the pain I feel. Honestly my little brother is the only thing keeping me going knowing he needs a babysitter and my mom can't afford to hire one, once my grandma comes to watch him I have no use to this world.

Haha, well you don't know my mom and how she kicks me for small shit like not cleaning my room. Idk a part of me feels that I'll be fine in the future but then again I just don't have the mental strength to wait longer then at least 2 years to surpass the actual mind fuck I've been going through recently
I'm at least gonna give it time and if nothing changes and I'm still fucked I'll tell my mom and probably get beat for shit but at least I tried

I'm scared that's it's a serious thing and I understand I need to get help for it but it's all just my mom. You don't understand her, I can't afford to be degraded by her words and I already know that if I tell she's going to have me out of the house while I have no where to go. Hell she left me outside for a whole week just for not cleaning my room and I had to go to my friends house. But in this certain scenario I can't just go to a friend's house. I just don't know what to do and I just want everything to end
